aarti.tek: Victory to you, Mother Ahoī; victory to you, Mother Ahoī. Night and day Śiva, Viṣṇu and Brahmā the Creator meditate on you.
aarti.pad1: You are Brahmāṇī, Rudrāṇī and Kamalā; you alone are the giver to the world. The Sun and the Moon meditate on you, and the sage Nārada sings of you. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: Mother, your form is stainless, and you give happiness and wealth; whoever meditates on you gains blessings always. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: You alone dwell in the netherworld, and you alone give happiness; you bring to light the fruit of deeds and save from the ocean of the world. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: In the home where you dwell, virtues arrive; what a person could not do, he does, and his mind is not afraid. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: Without you there is no happiness, and no one gains a son; the plenty of food and drink does not come without you. ॥5॥
aarti.pad6: You are endowed with auspicious virtues and beauty, born of the ocean of milk; of the fourteen jewels, none attains to you. ॥6॥
aarti.pad7: Whoever sings the āratī of Śrī Ahoī Mother, great joy wells up in his heart, and his sins fall away. ॥7॥
